verdict.rationale: Lorikeet is a SaaS AI customer-support platform. Offering its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions public source code, a repository, or an open-source license. The MCP server, llms.txt and trust-center items concern access and documentation, not source openness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
